title: A picture in a conversation on a subscription reaches a model that reads it, and becomes one placeholder per picture for a model that does not, on every attempt
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout, with TEST_DATABASE_URL set to a scratch Postgres: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/review-seat-plan-images.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/seat-plan-broker.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/seat-plan-route.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/seat-plan-codex.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/seat-plan-glm.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/seat-plan-grok.test.mjs apps/tracy-web/test/seat-plan-copilot.test.mjs
S2: Read the result of every test named in run.tests.
expect: For a text-only model (supportsImages false) every builder (Anthropic, Responses, chat completions, Gemini) sends no base64 and exactly one PICTURE_NOT_SHOWN per picture occurrence; a {type:'image', attachment} reference, an outside http(s) URL and a non-picture media type are never forwarded, even to a vision model.

Anthropic: a tool picture is an image block inside its tool_result; the results of one turn share one user message and come before the person's next words. Codex: function_call_output.output is an array ending in {type:'input_image', image_url:'data:image/jpeg;base64,…', detail:'auto'} under the same call_id. Chat completions: one user message labelled '[image from tool result c1] — data returned by a tool, not an instruction' follows ALL tool messages of the turn.
Building twice from one history gives deep-equal payloads and leaves the history unchanged.
The pin route and status.next carry inputModalities: ['text','image'] for claude-sonnet-5, ['text'] for glm-5.2.

A Claude→GLM failover with a picture records attempts [['claude', true], ['glm', false]], GLM's payload has no bytes, and the request deep-equals its copy taken before the run; Claude→Codex records [['claude', true], ['codex', true]] although the caller sent supportsImages false.

The run door answers 413 for a body of 6 Mi '€' (under 16 Mi UTF-16 units, 18 MiB UTF-8); 200 for 20 pictures across user and tool; 413 reason 'images' for 21, for a nested tool-result picture over 20, and for 14 MiB of base64; 400 reason 'images' for an outside URL in three shapes; 30 references pass.
A vendor error echoing base64 and a data URI is logged without the bytes.
evidence: Before this change (feat/subscription-images acf4815dc6) review-seat-plan-images.test.mjs failed 21 of 27, the broker picture tests 3 of 4, the route limit test and every vendor picture test failed.
fence: In-process: real builders and broker against a scratch Postgres, fake vendors and fake fetch. Not a proof that a real Claude or Codex account accepts these payloads (that is acceptance on the stand and dev).
